task: D6.1 opt-in read-only submission detail/filter review/broadcast shadow
decision: The existing submission detail/filter pages keep their URLs, legacy attempt rows, category filters, pagination, and legacy data source. An explicit manager_compare=true request attaches the same read-only review/broadcast manager shadow used by the submission overview page; it does not replace any legacy row logic or call write endpoints.

implementation.partialFailurePolicy: Every detail/filter route reuses the submission shadow helper. Review and broadcast reads remain independent; one side failing yields ok=false, partial=true, and retains the successful side plus a structured upstream error.
implementation.cachePolicy: The failed/success/review route families skip legacy submission cache reads and writes when manager_compare=true. The dedicated review-success/review-failed/execution-success/execution-failed record routes do not use the legacy submission cache and attach the shadow only on explicit opt-in.

fixtures: all nine submission detail/filter routes attach managerShadow only when manager_compare=true
ordinary detail/filter requests keep legacy rows, category counts, source, and no managerShadow field
cache-backed failed/success/review route families skip legacy cache reads and writes under manager_compare=true
dedicated review-success/review-failed/execution-success/execution-failed routes remain cache-free and attach shadow only on opt-in
shadow reuse returns review/broadcast versions, checksums, status counts, and snapshot counts
one-side review/broadcast failure remains partial=true with the successful side retained
all shadow reads contain chainId and do not call review/broadcast write endpoints
knownBoundary: Submission detail/filter shadow is a read-only diagnostic. The legacy attempt detail endpoint /api/dex/submissions/detail still reads SQLite directly because manager_api has no attempt-detail read endpoint yet; it is called out as the next API gap rather than faked. No row-level review/broadcast compare endpoint exists, comparisonReadyForFieldSwitch remains false, and no production database migration, service restart, manager write, or broadcast was performed.
